neighbours.label: the capitalised head noun 'Sector' or 'Industry' closing a named economic-sector phrase ('Financial Services Sector', 'Steel Industry'); weaker on other collective heads (community, movement, system)
fire: Employment in the Norwegian Offshore Wind Sector doubled between 2010 and 2020.
A new study of the Canadian Timber Industry and its export markets came out this week.
Wages in the Welsh Creative Arts Sector remain below the national average.
The lecture traced the rise of the German Chemical Industry and its links to the universities.
Output from the Kenyan Cut Flower Sector was valued at half a billion dollars.
Her thesis looks at the Japanese Video Game Industry and the firms that shaped it.
Investment in the Scottish Life Sciences Sector was praised by the committee.
The chapter describes the British Cotton Industry and the towns that grew around it.
quiet: Employment on Norwegian offshore wind farms doubled between 2010 and 2020.

Wages for Welsh artists and designers remain below the national average.

Cut flowers grown in Kenya were valued at half a billion dollars.
Her thesis looks at Japanese video games and the firms that made them.

notes: Weak pole (max 7.25) with a wide low band (0.87% of tokens above 0.1). Card: ' Sector' x2, ' Industry', 'REGIME', ' movement', ' community', ' system', ' Guidelines', ' rules' as heads of compound names. Probes: ' Sector' 0.36-0.47, ' Industry' 0.41-0.60 before 'and', but <0.08 for a text-final 'Dairy Industry'; ' movement' 0.09-0.16, ' community' 0.24; 'regime for' 0.56 (peak on ' for'). Only the Sector/Industry case is tested.
